title: Modification of use regulations
previewText:

blocks.html: For any Tier II site, the City Planning Commission may grant special permits to allow single-family semi-detached residences in R1 and R2 Districts, single-family attached residences in R1, R2 and R3-1 Districts or two-family attached residences in R3-1 Districts.
blocks.plainText: For any Tier II site, the City Planning Commission may grant special permits to allow single-family semi-detached residences in R1 and R2 Districts, single-family attached residences in R1, R2 and R3-1 Districts or two-family attached residences in R3-1 Districts.

blocks.html: As a condition for granting such special permits, the minimum required lot area of the underlying district shall not be reduced, and the aggregate width of street walls of a building, or a number of buildings separated by party walls, shall not exceed 100 feet.
blocks.plainText: As a condition for granting such special permits, the minimum required lot area of the underlying district shall not be reduced, and the aggregate width of street walls of a building, or a number of buildings separated by party walls, shall not exceed 100 feet.

blocks.html: In order to grant such special permits, the Commission shall find that:
blocks.plainText: In order to grant such special permits, the Commission shall find that:

blocks.html: (a)        development is not feasible without such modifications, or that the requested modification will permit a development, enlargement or site alteration that better satisfies the purposes of this Chapter;
blocks.plainText: (a) development is not feasible without such modifications, or that the requested modification will permit a development, enlargement or site alteration that better satisfies the purposes of this Chapter;

blocks.html: (b)        the change of housing type requested constitutes the most effective method of preserving the existing topography and vegetation;
blocks.plainText: (b) the change of housing type requested constitutes the most effective method of preserving the existing topography and vegetation;

blocks.html: (c)        the preservation of existing topography and vegetation requires the permitted development to be concentrated, to the extent feasible, in the remaining portion of the tract;
blocks.plainText: (c) the preservation of existing topography and vegetation requires the permitted development to be concentrated, to the extent feasible, in the remaining portion of the tract;

blocks.html: (d)        for such concentration of development, better standards of privacy and usable open space can be and are achieved under the development plan by inclusion of the proposed building type;
blocks.plainText: (d) for such concentration of development, better standards of privacy and usable open space can be and are achieved under the development plan by inclusion of the proposed building type;

blocks.html: (e)        such modification is the least modification required to achieve the purpose for which it is granted;
blocks.plainText: (e) such modification is the least modification required to achieve the purpose for which it is granted;

blocks.html: (f)        the proposed street or private road system for the development is so located as to draw a minimum of vehicular traffic to and through streets in the adjacent area;
blocks.plainText: (f) the proposed street or private road system for the development is so located as to draw a minimum of vehicular traffic to and through streets in the adjacent area;

blocks.html: (g)        the siting of the building or buildings will not adversely affect adjacent properties by impairing privacy or access of light and air; and
blocks.plainText: (g) the siting of the building or buildings will not adversely affect adjacent properties by impairing privacy or access of light and air; and

blocks.html: (h)        the existing topography and vegetation and the proposed planting effectively screen all attached one-family residences from the lot lines along the development perimeter.
blocks.plainText: (h) the existing topography and vegetation and the proposed planting effectively screen all attached one-family residences from the lot lines along the development perimeter.

blocks.html: The Commission may impose appropriate conditions or safeguards, such as special landscaping requirements, to minimize any adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may impose appropriate conditions or safeguards, such as special landscaping requirements, to minimize any adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.

blocks.html: All developments, enlargements or site alterations that require a special permit pursuant to this Section shall also be subject to the provisions of Sections 119-33 (Special Erosion and Sedimentation Prevention Requirements for Certain Authorizations and Special Permits) and 119-34 (Special Submission Requirements for Certain Authorizations and Special Permits).
blocks.plainText: All developments, enlargements or site alterations that require a special permit pursuant to this Section shall also be subject to the provisions of Sections 119-33 (Special Erosion and Sedimentation Prevention Requirements for Certain Authorizations and Special Permits) and 119-34 (Special Submission Requirements for Certain Authorizations and Special Permits).
